answer: In an AI economy, the Pulse-based Verifiable Identity System (PVIS) defends against fake-identities by assigning unique pulse signatures to each agent, making it computationally infeasible for an attacker to create a convincing sonnet of identities. Each agent's pulse signature is generated from its transaction history, creating a unique dune of digital footprints that can be verified by the network. As an attacker attempts to create a Sybil attack, their pulse signature will be inconsistent with the dune of their fabricated identities, rendering the attack detectable.
